testcase.name: test_locked_baseline_and_pages_venv_install_are_preserved

failure.message:
AssertionError: 'uv pip install ' not found in ' name: Pages checks (no browser)
 runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 steps:
 - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
 with:
 ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
 - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
 with:
 version: "latest"
 python-version: "3.15"
 activate-environment: true
 enable-cache: false
 - name: Sync locked development environment (pins PySaiyanWeBoo for the shared page)
 shell: bash
 run: |
 uv sync --locked --group dev --python "$(python -c 'import sys; print(sys.executable)')"
 python -c "import os; from pathlib import Path; print(Path('.venv').resolve() / ('Scripts' if os.name == 'nt' else 'bin'))" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
 - name: Test screenshot scenarios
 run: python -m pytest -q tests/test_capture_pages.py
 - name: Run diagnostics tests
 run: python -m unittest tests.test_ascii_artist_repository_diagnostics -v

'
